definition.title: Quoted scalar parser support

runtimeChecks.name: fence-quoted-primitives-preserved
runtimeChecks.script:
import { extractBlocks } from './src/index.mjs'; const fence = String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3); const md = '## 123
' + fence + 'mermaid title="123" subtitle='false' legend=false
flowchart TD
A-->B
' + fence + '
'; const block = extractBlocks(md, [])[0]; if (!block) { console.error('expected one block, got none'); process.exit(1); } const actual = { title: block.options?.title, titleType: typeof block.options?.title, subtitle: block.options?.subtitle, subtitleType: typeof block.options?.subtitle, legend: block.options?.legend, legendType: typeof block.options?.legend }; const expected = { title: '123', titleType: 'string', subtitle: 'false', subtitleType: 'string', legend: false, legendType: 'boolean' }; if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) { console.error('expected=' + JSON.stringify(expected) + ' actual=' + JSON.stringify(actual)); process.exit(1); }

definition.title: Quoted comma list parsing

runtimeChecks.name: quoted-inline-list-commas-preserved
runtimeChecks.script:
import { extractBlocks, parseYamlite } from './src/index.mjs'; const fence = String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3); const parsed = parseYamlite('lanes: ["Root, global", Apps]
'); const md = '## lanes
' + fence + 'mermaid
%%| lanes: ["Root, global", Apps]
flowchart TD
A-->B
' + fence + '
'; const block = extractBlocks(md, [])[0]; if (!block) { console.error('expected one block, got none'); process.exit(1); } const actual = { yamlLanes: parsed?.lanes, directiveLanes: block.options?.lanes }; const expected = { yamlLanes: ['Root, global', 'Apps'], directiveLanes: ['Root, global', 'Apps'] }; if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) { console.error('expected=' + JSON.stringify(expected) + ' actual=' + JSON.stringify(actual)); process.exit(1); }
